South Metro Real Estate Market Recap - Nov 20 to Nov 26

Rates first: the 30-year fixed averaged 7.21% as of Nov 25, down from 7.28% the week before (Freddie Mac). Prices: Redfin's Home Price Index has Atlanta prices down 0.1% in October from September and up 2.3% from a year earlier (Redfin, Nov 24, three months ending Oct 31). Local: Newton County's school system is looking at consolidating some elementary schools, because enrollment has dropped, with two public meetings on Monday, Dec 7 and Thursday, Dec 10, both at 6 p.m., at the Newton College and Career Academy, 144 Ram Dr., Covington (Covington News, Nov 25). General information from the sources named, for the dates shown. Not loan advice. Talk to your lender about your own rate.
